image.publisher: local build; no prebuilt image published
image.entrypoint_bypass: Launchers invoke the vLLM CLI through a login shell to activate the bundled CUDA compatibility driver. The inherited base-image attestation does not cover the replaced Python packages.

model.dflash_config_note: Revisions before b2674c72176d008cb675a09f626f8eba3f3f21c4 ship dflash/config.json with a trailing comma; the launchers mount a corrected copy (fix_dflash_config.py) when the checkpoint's file does not parse. config.json, model.safetensors.index.json and the draft weights are unchanged across those revisions.

evidence.pair_status: research-only; B12X target/draft composition has not been launched on TP2

base_image.native_extensions: Retained from the base image; the builder replaces Python packages without compiling CUDA extensions.
base_image.measurement_note: TP4 measurements used parent c57f939fde8ca5d7134f20ec1da6a16321dd023e662ce2392d94e14390de71a1, a local child of this digest containing its verification-generated cache layer. Rebuilding directly from the published parent has not been benchmarked.
